NAME THAT AI — ITEMS (5 minutes)
Go through each item ONE BY ONE. For each one: 1. Point to the card dramatically 2. Let the class shout their answer 3. Pause one second 4. Reveal: "ALL AI! Every single one."
SPECIFIC TALKING POINTS (use 1-2 per item): - X-Ray: "AIIMS Delhi's AI reads 500 X-rays in the time a doctor reads 1" - WhatsApp sticker: "That 'face-ify' sticker maker? Trained on millions of faces" - Self-driving: "It's already on some Bengaluru tech park campuses" - Chess: "The computer that beat the world chess champion — that was AI. In 1997. When your parents were students." - YouTube: "AI chooses what video plays next. It knows you better than your own parents." - Weather: "100 years ago, no one could predict weather 10 days ahead. AI now does it with 90% accuracy."
CLOSING LINE (say it slowly, let it echo): "AI is not in the future. It is already... in your breakfast." (pause) "The app that told your mummy which sabzi to buy today? AI. The Swiggy recommendation? AI. The autocorrect that fixed your WhatsApp message? AI."
Then advance.
